releaseNotes: Fixed: attachment Open could silently do nothing on some machines; now uses the OS's own open command, with Choose App / Reveal File when there's no default app (e.g. .dwg, .step). Uploads now show progress and a completion confirmation. App version shown on login and main screens; jigs with attachments show a paperclip count in the list.
releaseNotesZh: 修復：附件「Open」在部分電腦上可能沒反應；改用系統原生開啟方式，沒有預設程式時（如 .dwg、.step）可選擇程式開啟或顯示檔案位置。上傳附件現在會顯示進度與完成提示。登入頁與主畫面顯示版本號，治具列表有附件會顯示迴紋針數量。
